title: DriftNeRF: Cross-Ray Density Drifting for Sparse-View Neural Radiance Fields
abstract: arXiv:2610.29106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) synthesize photorealistic novel views from dense image collections, but degrade sharply when few views are available. We attribute a specific, measurable defect to the objective itself: the rendering loss is a sum over independent rays and contains no term comparing densities that different rays assign to the same region of space, so nearby 3D points can settle on contradictory densities while every training pixel is reproduced correctly. We make this quantity explicit by measuring cross-ray density disagreement directly during training, and show that it stays high in vanilla NeRF, falls only incidentally under frequency-based regularization, and moves together with held-out quality in the sparse regime. translated_title: DriftNeRF：面向稀疏视角神经辐射场的跨射线密度漂移
translated_abstract: 神经辐射场（NeRF）能够从密集的图像集合中合成照片级真实感的新视角，但在可用视角较少时性能会急剧下降。我们将一个具体的、可度量的缺陷归因于其目标函数本身：渲染损失是对各独立射线的求和，其中不包含任何用于比较不同射线赋予空间同一区域密度的项，因此在每个训练像素都能被正确再现的同时，相邻的三维点却可能收敛到相互矛盾的密度值。我们通过在训练过程中直接测量跨射线密度不一致性，使这一量变得显式，并证明它在原始NeRF中始终维持较高水平，在基于频率的正则化下只是偶然下降，而且在稀疏视角场景中与留出集渲染质量同步变化。随后，我们提出DriftNeRF来弥补这一缺陷——它是一种即插即用的正则化器，在密度样本上实例化了漂移场模板：利用一个带掩码的指数核，从其他射线上的邻近点聚合密度信息（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出DriftNeRF，一种即插即用的正则化器，通过带掩码的指数核从其他射线聚合邻近点密度，解决了稀疏视角下NeRF目标函数因缺乏跨射线密度一致性约束而导致的密度矛盾问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DriftNeRF, a drop-in regularizer that aggregates densities from neighboring points on other rays via a masked exponential kernel, resolving the contradictory density problem in sparse-view NeRF caused by the lack of cross-ray density consistency in the rendering objective.
